Lovers of American music can boast of no more famous husband and wife duo than Jackie & Roy. Jackie Cain and Roy Kral first worked together in the band of Charlie Ventura in 1948 and were married a year later. They established a recognizable sound with their recordings of “East of Suez” and “Flamingo.”

Their career has taken them from the clubs of Las Vegas, to the TV studios of Chicago, the stages of jazz festivals and the ad agencies of New York. They have recorded frequently with top jazz artists and a release by Jackie & Roy always delivers the highest level of musicianship. The perfect blend of their voices and the signature sound of Roy’s arrangements have made possible a swinging collaboration that recently celebrated its fiftieth anniversary.
Jackie & Roy were interviewed in New York City on March 22, 1998, by Monk Rowe, Director of the Fillius Jazz Archive at Hamilton College.
